title: Derived scalar extension of a closed supported constant sheaf
statement:
Let $i:D\hookrightarrow Z$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $A\to B\to C$ be homomorphisms of finite commutative rings. Work on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], ordinary module direct image $i_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Use derived scalar extension $-\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$ and its adjunction with termwise restriction [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings, lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. The map $i_*A_D\to\operatorname{Res}_{A\to B}(i_*B_D)$ induced by the coefficient unit has an adjunct
$$\alpha_{A,B}:(i_*A_D)\otimes_{A_Z}^{\mathbf L}B_Z\longrightarrow i_*B_D.$$
This specified comparison is an isomorphism. It is natural in the coefficient homomorphism, is the identity for $A\to A$, and satisfies
$$\alpha_{B,C}\circ(\alpha_{A,B}\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}C)=\alpha_{A,C}\circ a_{A,B,C,i_*A_D},$$
where $a_{A,B,C,K}:(K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B)\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}C\xrightarrow{\sim}K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}C$ is the canonical transitivity isomorphism of [lem-sfb-successive-derived-quotient-normalization] for the constant ring sheaves $A_Z\to B_Z\to C_Z$. Neither coefficient homomorphism is assumed flat.
